title.narrative: Driving social accountability to accelerate implementation of the SDGs in Liberia

description.narrative: As a way of engaging and promoting CAFOD’s commitment to Pope Francis, Laudato Si’ that calls for an integrated approach to combating poverty, restoring the dignity to the excluded and to hear the cry of the earth and the cry of the poor, this work fulfils part of the blueprints to realising this vision and lays the foundation for CAFOD’s development priorities. While international agreements such as Agenda 2030 and the Paris climate agreement deal with a wide range of issues and implementation challenges, CAFODs Agenda T-2020 Action is endearing to look at ways these broad but all highly important goals are incorporated within national frameworks and how the embolden hope that promises to “leave no one behind” can be universally achieved. This project will focus on supporting CAFOD partner - National Commission of Justice, Peace and Caritas (NCJPC) to engage with CSOs at national level to influence government for the effective implementation and monitoring of Agenda 2030. NCJPC will benefit the following: Understand Agenda 2030, ensure meaningful participation and measure real progress of CSOs involved.
